description: Defines the Chart class in the PdfSharp.Charting namespace, representing various chart types with properties for axes, series, plot area, and cloning functionality.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Represents a chart with various axes, series, and display properties, supporting deep copying and axis type checking.

methods.name: Chart(DocumentObject parent)
